text:
CLINICAL FEATURES OF PELVIC INFLAMMATORY DISEASES
Clinical Features
- Major criteria (the Westrom triad):
  · Lower abdominal pain and tenderness
  · Cervical excitation tenderness
  · Adnexal tenderness
- Minor criteria
  · Fever (38 degrees C)
  · Leucocytosis
  · Purulent vaginal discharge
  · Adnexal mass
